content_sections.body: Read this model: 'I have considered retelling a media story, and my experience shows one useful reason for this view.' Identify the main point, the linking expression, and the supporting detail. Then explain how the wording helps the speaker achieve this objective: Retell the main sequence of a familiar media story.
content_sections.title: Notice the connected language (10 minutes)

content_sections.body: Work with a partner in a discussion about retelling a media story. Give a clear main point, support it with a specific reason, and respond to one follow-up question. Use tactful language when the other speaker presents a different perspective.
content_sections.title: Guided exchange (10 minutes)

content_sections.body: Prepare a one-minute response about retelling a media story. Organize it into thought groups, stress the words that carry your main point, and finish with a concise conclusion rather than a list of isolated sentences.
content_sections.title: Independent connected response (8 minutes)
